name: new-public-project
description: Start a new open-source project secure from the first commit: scaffolds LICENSE, SECURITY.md, CODEOWNERS, PR and issue templates, CI (gitleaks, CodeQL, PR-title lint), Dependabot and a secret-blocking pre-commit hook, creates a private GitHub repo, then audits for secrets and personal data before making it public and applying branch protection, push protection and locked-down Actions.
